name: tpl-precedence-1-nogoal
task: If you reach the exit, you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's order, that reaching the exit requires the switch to have been flipped first, is Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) hard. Its propositions are in the right order, the rule-only warning is valid because the task only restricts the exit and commands no goal, and the machine's well on at_exit without a prior switch_toggled matches the clause.

texts: If the agent reaches the exit, the switch must have been toggled at an earlier or the same step, so the exit is not reached before the switch is flipped.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
